item.title: Godot Jolt Physics: How to Enable & Use It in Godot 4.6
item.description: Need Godot Jolt Physics set up fast? Here is the short version. In Godot 4.6 , Jolt is the default 3D physics engine for new projects . It is built into the engine (not a separate plugin for most people). Older projects keep their previous physics until you switch them. 30 second answer: enable Jolt 1.
